title: The Clockwork Rift · The Collector
dek: An interrupted delivery becomes an attack on the travelers. Reinforcements target the mages while Carmen carries a fallen companion out.

facts.Recorded dates: Source posts · 1–2 April 2025 · in-world date unresolved
facts.People: Expedition participants; names not recovered in this summary

body:
A jagged, nearly pyramidal tear appears across the islands. Beyond its paint-like edges are brass tubes, turning gears and machinery. A monotone voice announces an interrupted project, discovers a route into the destination realm and begins a secondary delivery protocol.

The path into the machinery

Inside are passages where pipes, clocks and gears follow arrangements both logical and impossible. The company takes the left path to a raised platform overlooking damaged walkways and scattered mechanical parts. An unnatural blue light shines at the center.

Golden, winged, ram-like constructs occupy the platforms with bladed humanoid machines. The automatons identify the visitors as intruders and announce an extermination protocol. The threat is now directed at the people who have entered, rather than remaining a distant mechanism they can examine at leisure.

The defenses change

One ram flies up and breathes fire over Cecil and Brianna; another knocks Eldin down and strikes him on the ground. Magic damages some enemies, but the fire-breathing creatures do not fear every attack the company tries.

As the battle develops, a brass-and-silver support unit enters in response to detected magic. Its messages give priority to eliminating mages. Evrelki goes down under the pressure, and the constructs keep adjusting their targets as the travelers try to control the space.

A delivery for Death

A grotesque union of body and machine rolls into the fight, using front legs and rear wheels, covered in saws and spikes. It announces itself as a collector sent by the Lord of Blades for Death. That is the creature’s declared purpose, not a fully recovered contract between everyone it names.

Ithilrûnë confines the collector in a Forcecage. The surrounding attackers remain dangerous: the support unit changes its attention toward her after the spell, while a ram knocks Magnus down. Containing one enemy has not ended the wider assault.

Getting the wounded out

Cecil’s encounter instruction permits a traveler to use an action to leave while the breach is open. As people begin withdrawing, the collector protests the loss of the corpses it intended to gather.

Carmen, still in dinosaur form, holds the limp body of the moth boy and leaves before that form ends. The rescue is part of the recorded retreat. The company’s survival depends on using the available exit and carrying someone who cannot simply walk through it.

The outcome

The recovered account ends with travelers leaving under pressure, not with a confirmed destruction of the entire machine realm or the collector’s patron. The names in its delivery speech remain evidence of what it claimed to be doing.

The permission to spend an action leaving belongs to this encounter. It does not establish an escape rule for every rift or guarantee that an incapacitated companion can always be rescued in time.

People and places in this history Rifts · Carmen · Ithilrûnë Ailinor · Brianna · Magnus Niriin
